results.content: * MALS 74600 Introduction to Global Early Modern Studies, 3 credits. * MALS 74700 Special Topics in Global Early Modern Studies, 3 credits. * MALS 70600 Introduction to Global Modern and Contemporary Studies, 3 credits. * MALS 74600 Introduction to Global Early Modern Studies**,** 3 credits. **MALS 72000: Thesis Writing Course, 3 credits**. This online, synchronous course is a three-credit research and writing course open to all MALS students currently working on their theses. In order to allow students to explore their own interests and work on their academic research and writing, the course will include a number of shorter writing assignments, including responding to a keyword from one of the Keywords for American Cultural Studies volumes, writing a review of an artifact or event, creating and presenting an annotated bibliography, and drafting a proposal for a research project or submitting an excerpt from a longer work in progress. **MALS 74700: Special Topics in Global Early Modern Studies 3 credits**.
